info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_ATM Network Operations Status API
info.description: The ATM Network Operations Status API provides real-time updates and information regarding the operational status of ATM networks across channels. This endpoint allows consumers to monitor the availability and functioning of ATMs, enabling them to quickly assess network health. Typical use cases include integration in banking applications, customer service portals, and operational dashboards. Financial institutions and third-party service providers can leverage this API to enhance customer experiences and manage service availability efficiently.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of ATM network operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of ATM network operations, providing essential information about operational health and performance metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the ATM network operations specific to the channel. Ensure that the JSON payload adheres to the specified schema to facilitate accurate processing of the request.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the current status of the ATM network operations is returned.

GetAtmNetworkOperationStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for getting the status of ATM network operations.

regionCode.description: Region code where the ATM is located

serviceWindow.description: Details about the service window for the ATM

dailyCapacity.description: The daily transaction capacity of the ATM

cashStatus.description: Current cash status of the ATM (e.g. 'In Service', 'Out of Service')

terminalHealth.description: Health status of the ATM terminal (e.g. 'Healthy', 'Requires Maintenance')

updatedAt.description: Timestamp for the last update of the record

metadata.description: Metadata related to the ATM status response

GetAtmNetworkOperationStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving the status of ATM network operations, including channel details and service information.

opensAt.description: Time when the service window opens

closesAt.description: Time when the service window closes

ServiceWindow.description: Represents the operating hours of the ATM service window.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated

processingRegion.description: Region where the response was processed

Metadata.description: Metadata contains additional information about the ATM status response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Uniquely identifies the endpoint that processed the request. This is primarily used for monitoring and logging.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the request. This helps identify which service is responsible for the response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for bearer authentication. Clients must include a valid JWT in the 'Authorization' header of their requests using the format 'Bearer {token}'.
